name: Launch Complex 39A
best_known_for: Launched all Apollo lunar missions; today flies Falcon 9, Falcon Heavy, and Crew Dragon
credit: Operational pad at NASA Kennedy Space Center. Saturn V era 1967-1973 (Apollo 4 through Skylab); Shuttle era 1981-2011 (STS); SpaceX Crew Dragon + Falcon Heavy era 2017-present. Coordinates and operational history from NASA KSC fact sheets and FAA registry.
